author: National Geographic
description:
In this To Catch A Smuggler season 9 Mega Episode, join Homeland Security Investigations (HSI) and U.S. Customs and border Protection (CPB) officers as they work non-stop to interceptio illegal narcotics, high-value contraband, and other smuggling operations. From bustling international airports like JFK and Miami, to Texas border entry points in El Paso, follow federal agents through tense interrogations and high-stakes inspections. 

Featuring three, full episodes: 

Meth Hot Chili Peppers - 00:00
CBP finds meth worth millions inside a shipment of chili peppers in Texas. HSI Miami conducts back-to-back operations involving firearms and ketamine. 

Snitching on Mom - 44:06
CBP El Paso uncovers a massive meth load in a railcar, and HSI Miami investigates a counterfeit passport ring, with a son implicating his own mother.

Bud Bound for Britain - 1:28:12
CBP Newark finds suitcases of weed bound for the UK. Agents stop sisters involved in human smuggling in El Paso and intercept ancient
